annotation: Annotated on the raw video. Frame indices at about 30 fps; extracted frame fNNNN is video frame 30 * NNNN. touch = first frame the hand touches the piece, in the contact that ends with the piece lifted; pick = first frame the piece leaves the table; insert = first frame the piece touches the part it is mounted on (for the base: first frame it rests at the work position); mount = the piece reaches its slot, as first annotated: for some pieces this is the first contact (arm_2), for others the piece pushed in (mouth, nose and moustache), so insert is the uniform definition; hands_off = hands leave the figure; tol = estimate of the ambiguity of pick and mount, in frames. Sides are in image coordinates.
revision: 2026-10-09: checked event by event on the raw video, after perception outputs on this video had been seen. Added touch and insert (precision about 2-4 frames), corrected the notes on the nose touch and on the ear put back, made the definition of mount explicit. pick, mount and hands_off unchanged.
